links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of LLMs versus neurologists (concordance with discharge diagnoses)
links.effect: Neurologists achieved 75% diagnostic accuracy, outperforming ChatGPT (54%) and Gemini (46%); LLMs overprescribed diagnostic tests in 17%-25% of cases.
links.quote: Neurologists achieved a diagnostic accuracy of 75%, outperforming ChatGPT (54%) and Gemini (46%).

links.outcome: LLM clinical reasoning and test appropriateness on real-world neurology cases
links.effect: Both LLMs showed limitations in nuanced clinical reasoning and overprescribed diagnostic tests in 17%-25% of cases; accuracy 54% (ChatGPT) and 46% (Gemini).
links.quote: Both LLMs demonstrated limitations in nuanced clinical reasoning and overprescribed diagnostic tests in 17%-25% of cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical recommendation appropriateness of ChatGPT and Gemini compared to neurologists using retrospective anonymized clinical vignettes without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
